The compiler is the app's own managed Tectonic, installed through the app's 'Install compiler' route.
data_notes: Every paper, person, journal and citation is fictional; the bibliography entries do not refer to real publications.
Each paper's 'Last edited' time is the moment the capture created it, from the gateway's clock.
The grazing-abstract paper is seeded with an undefined macro (\tempdiff) on purpose, to show the compiler's error list.

tide-pool-heat
body.content:
\section{Introduction}
Rock pools are a refuge at low tide, but a shallow pool in full sun can become
a trap. Earlier surveys measured pools once or twice a day
\citep{quill2021pools}; continuous loggers show how fast the water warms and
how long the peak lasts \citep{okafor2023loggers}.

body.name: tide-pool-heat
body.content:
\section{Methods}
We fixed one temperature logger to the floor of each of twelve pools between
the high-water mark and the mid shore. Each pool was measured for depth at its
deepest point and for surface area from a top-down photograph. Loggers recorded
every ten minutes from June to August, and we kept only the hours when the pool
was cut off from the sea.
